friendly_name: Retry delivery to a sleeping peer
purpose_context: Federation currently delivers once and never retries, so a peer that is asleep, restarting or briefly offline turns an ordinary message into a failure. That is the common case for the hubs this project actually runs: the public demo suspends when idle and laptops sleep. This mission adds a short retry window so those sends succeed on their own, while keeping the guarantee that authorization is re-decided at the moment of each attempt and never inherited from when the message was queued.
purpose_tldr: A federated message to a peer that is briefly unreachable is retried rather than lost, and the sender can see which.
